name: Google Workspace Business Starter
shortDescription: Google Workspace Business Starter is a collaborative productivity suite with professional business email, Gemini, Google Meet for up to 100 participants, Docs, Calendar, Chat, administrative controls, and 30 GB of pooled storage per user.
summary: Google Workspace Business Starter provides specialized capabilities in productivity & notes, delivering intuitive features, flexible integration options, and team reliability.
